answer: Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. The sparrow of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The beacon holds work receipts rather than names, so the glacier of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, split across independent auditors.
